title: NZ MBIE Determination 2025/034 (comparative): proposed amendment, uPVC joinery in a converted garage
jurisdiction: New Zealand (Building Act 2004); Auckland Council; comparative only, not Alberta

facts.text: The authority refused to grant an amendment to building consent BCO10361217 for installing new uPVC door and window joinery in an alteration to an existing building.
The alteration converts an existing garage to a habitable studio unit, with direct-fixed horizontal fibre-cement weatherboard cladding.
The existing garage had four windows, two shutter doors and one single-leaf door, all to be removed.
The building is in a medium wind zone.
The owner relies on a previous determination (2016/059) for the same manufacturer's joinery.
